propositions: Autodeploy recreates the review-bot container without draining in-flight reviews, killing reviews mid-execution when landing bursts compress deploy intervals below review completion time
The reconciler's review_and_vote path runs outside the shutdown queue protection, making reconciler retries vulnerable to process termination while the webhook-queued path is protected
A killed review produces no VOTER_ERROR signal, so health monitors and alarms report green while the gate is fully live-locked, creating a blind spot in observability
The live-lock cannot converge during landing bursts where deploys arrive faster than reviews complete, because the self-heal retry path is the exact mechanism being killed

Deploys are deferred when in-flight reviews are detected via a busy signal on the existing /health endpoint, bounded at 1800s keyed to the deferral episode to prevent soft-lockout during burst sequences
Two new countable tokens (AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED and AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT) make deferral and bound-exceeded conditions alarmed and visible, closing the observability gap
